title: No Rest for the Living
description: No Rest for the Living is a nine-level Doom II expansion consisting of eight standard maps and one secret level. Set on Earth after Hell's forces have seemingly been vanquished, the campaign follows the fight to stop a Cyberdemon attempting to reopen the gateway between Hell and Earth. Designed as a homage to classic nine-map Doom episodes, it features reordered Bobby Prince music tracks.
notes: Imported from an owned GOG release (nerve.wad). [DoomWiki](https://doomwiki.org/wiki/No_Rest_for_the_Living)
